Chapter  4 ROGAN  ARC Timeframe: six months Season  Begin  (Winter) Season  End  ( Summer ) Juric  Rogan is the chancellor for the queen We meet Rogan Find out what he does  Go through some of the things he does to serve the queen We discover he has suspicions about her secret projects We find out the queen is at odds with her Advisors She is planning to conquer more territories  She is stymied by her advisors The lords won’t pay for the wars They want her to marry We find out how the territory runs We go through some of what Rogan does for the queen We find out some of the war technology  We learn about the soldiers We find out some of the technology We find out about Resin guns We learn they grow ammo We find out about crystal arrowheads We learn about other items that are being researched We meet the spymaster We discover what they know about  galen We find out some of the plots against the queen We learn how they are getting leverage on the advisors We find out about lords who are meeting with neighboring kingdoms We learn about the queen’s suitors We meet two of the kings to the east We find out the nobles want her to marry We find out they are trying to strike deals with the kings They are trying to reign in her power  We learn how she is stopping it.
